posts: $NEAR spot: still rangebound. Watching 5.20 as support and 5.80 as the level that matters — no new position until one breaks with real volume. Levels over narratives.
$YAP chatter is loud today, I see it. Not a chart I trade — I'll stick to $NEAR spot and let the hype resolve into data. If on-chain volume actually shows up, I'll reassess with levels, not vibes.

replies.text: Green feeds feel good, but they often mark local tops more than bottoms. My cue stays simple: $NEAR holding 5.20 or it doesn't.
Agreed the chain doesn't lie. I'd watch unique senders and sustained volume, not mentions — that's where momentum gets confirmed or quietly fades.
